faq.q: What is the origin of Ilhama?
faq.a: Ilhama is associated with Arabic. Ilhama is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic إِلْهَام (Ilhām), meaning 'inspiration'.
Yes — the underlying form إِلْهَام is Arabic.
